items.title: Cybercrime Laws and Data Protection Policies in Pakistan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Cybercrime Laws and Data Protection Policies in Pakistan (PDF 136, printed 132).

blocks.text: Pakistan mein cybercrime rokne aur digital maloomat bachane ke qawaneen hain. Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act (PECA) 2016 Pakistan ka bunyadi qanoon hai jo cybercrime se nimatta hai. Is ka maqsad afraad, idaron aur riyasat ko computers, mobile devices aur internet ke zariye hone wale ghair-qanooni kaamon se bachana hai. Yeh qawaneen hacking, identity theft, online fraud aur data tak unauthorized access ko shamil karte hain. Idaron ke liye hassas maloomat bachane ki khatir data protection policies par chalna lazmi hai. Cybercrime aur data privacy laws torne par qanooni sazayein hain. In qawaid par chalna mulk ke andar digital systems mein hifazat aur bharosa barqarar rakhta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab se aage (aam ilm)
blocks.text: GDPR un idaron par lagu hai jo European Union ke logon ka zaati data sambhalte hain, un idaron samet jo EU se bahar hain, maslan Pakistani company, magar EU ke logon ko maal ya khidmat dete ya un ke rawaiye ki nigrani karte hain. PECA mein 2025 mein tarmeem hui; taaza shiqon ke liye sarkari matan dekhein.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Talaba ek rehnuma worksheet ki madad se PECA mein shamil cybercrimes ki list banayein.

blocks.prompt: Pakistan mein cybercrime ka bunyadi qanoon kaun sa hai aur yeh kin jurmon ko cover karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act (PECA) 2016. Yeh hacking, identity theft, online fraud aur data tak be-ijazat rasai ko cover karta hai; khilaf-warzi par qanooni saza hai.

items: PECA 2016: Pakistan ka bunyadi cybercrime qanoon.
Organizations data protection policies follow karein; khilaf-warzi par saza.
